title: Link Shortener Work
heading: Build a link shortener that never loses a link
brief: Write the store behind the shortener and the checks that prove it: every code maps to one URL, a deleted code is never reused, expired links return 410, and each visit is counted once. Then load it at 10, 100 and 1000 links, checking the counts at each step.
